browser: Chrome for Testing, headless, fresh temporary profile, real unpacked extension, no optional grants

checks.name: Nothing opens a tab at install
Welcome card on a fresh profile; keyboard order Allow, Later, Close at 320 px; Choose sites later sets welcomeSeen
Allow requests http and https in the click; a (simulated) decline says so plainly and sets welcomeSeen
Close sets welcomeSeen
Settings: the all-sites switch shows the true state; the trigger offers a letter or the modifier only; the Never list lists and removes; each permission has a reason

reasons.allSites: Hold-key drag and Capture this page then work on every website without asking site by site. Link Meteor reads a page’s links only when you capture or drag, and keeps them in this browser.
reasons.site: Hold the key below and drag to select links, without opening Link Meteor first. Chrome asks for access to this site only.
reasons.tabGroups: A tab group is named after the collection when Chrome lets Link Meteor manage tab groups. Chrome asks the first time you choose one.

checks.name: Capture this page: no prompt after a toolbar press; on a new site whose address Chrome hides, a denied result says why and offers all sites (a decline changes nothing); a toolbar press there allows it
Card destination picker saves the ticked links to the chosen collection
Card copy formats: table, URLs (U) and Markdown (K)
Card Open 3 in tabs opens the unique ticked web links at once
Card Download this selection (D) saves a workbook named after the chosen collection
Card Bookmark this selection without access explains it and offers the full view
Card Review opens the full view at that capture, in its collection, once
Card with 30 links confirms first, then opens all 30 in batches
A theme or appearance change restyles a card already open on the page, without a reload (content.configure from the background)
Add right away saves at once and says so; Undo (capture.undoAdd) removes exactly that add; Show links then adds again from the card
Already saved: the card asks capture.saved and marks the 5 saved rows; Skip saved starts from the setting; Make this the default saves it (capture.preference)
Copy as rich links (L) puts the background’s HTML and plain text on the clipboard; the payload escapes anchor text and URLs
Skip saved: the card’s Add skips the 5 links already saved and says “Added 4 links …; 5 were already saved”
Capture this page with content links only leaves out 5 links in header (shadow root), nav, aside (frame) and footer, reports them, and Include them adds them once
Capture this page saves each link’s context and the page’s citation tags (Highwire, DOI read as a DOI) under the page’s address
Save tabs as links’ reader runs through Chrome’s executeScript as a stand-alone function and reads the same citation tags
A region saved from the card keeps each link’s context and the page’s citation tags
Save the words around each link (After a drag): on by default; off, Capture this page keeps no context but still reads the page’s citation

Save tabs as links (capture.tabs): three fixture tabs become three links with their titles and addresses, in one batch; a tab Chrome hides is reported, not saved; without site access no citation tags are read (This page’s tab, with the toolbar’s temporary access, is)
The tabs themselves with This page: the button says Save this tab as a link, saves the current tab, and fits at 320 px
Pick tabs: three tabs chosen, the button says Save 3 tabs as links, and the report says Saved 3 tabs as links and that reading citation details needs site access (tab access: simulated accept)
Save all tabs in this window without tab access: the full view opens with The tabs themselves and This window, says why, and asks in the save click (simulated decline)
Workbench: 20 links open without a confirmation
Workbench: a tab group without tab-group access (simulated decline) opens unnamed, with a note
Workbench: 45 links confirm inline (Open 45 tabs, new window, tab group, Cancel); a new window opens all 45
Workbench: 150 links use stronger wording, open in batches with progress, and Cancel stops before the next batch
Workbench: 520 links are refused before anything opens, in the page and in the background
A state saved by 0.2.2 shows the welcome card once, with the saved hold key
A second toolbar press closes the side panel: with Chrome’s own close, and without it by the panel itself; the full view stays open
The side panel’s Full view button is labeled, opens the full view in a tab and closes the panel
After Link Meteor restarts in place, region selection works on the same unreloaded page and its script answers messages
